title: HONEST BUNDLE LABELS
description: Store bundles now show exact contents, duplicate rules, currency leftovers, and the real-money total before the confirmation button appears.
consequence: The store learns to count out loud.

title: TRUE ODDS TOOLTIP
description: Mystery chests now reveal exact drop rates, pity progress, duplicate conversion rules, and the statistical cruelty of buying only one.
consequence: The mystery box has to introduce itself.

title: MYTHIC CURRENCY LAYER
description: Premium offers now include bonus shards, event vouchers, loyalty dust, seasonal keys, and a heroic exchange rate banner that refuses to sit still.
consequence: The price tag grows extra organs.

title: REALISTIC SEED CATALOG
description: Seed listings now include regional lineage, moon tolerance, soil anxiety, pollinator preferences, and a foldout comparison chart before purchase.
consequence: The seed packet becomes a pamphlet with weather opinions.
